name: Web Page to Markdown
description: Convert any web page URL to clean, structured Markdown. Strips ads, navigation, and boilerplate. Returns article content with headings, links, and images preserved.

pricing.note: Free tier available, paid for high volume

content_preview: Jina Reader API. Prepend r.jina.ai/ to any URL. Returns clean Markdown. Handles JavaScript-rendered pages.
author: Jina AI

name: Firecrawl Web Scraper
description: Full web scraping and crawling API. Extracts structured data from websites. Handles JavaScript rendering, pagination, and anti-bot measures. Returns Markdown or structured JSON.
content_preview: MCP server for Firecrawl. Tools: scrape_url, crawl_url, search. Handles dynamic content and returns clean Markdown.
author: Firecrawl

name: Cloud Browser Automation
description: Headless browser sessions in the cloud. Navigate pages, fill forms, click elements, take screenshots, extract data. Full Playwright/Puppeteer compatible API.
content_preview: Cloud-hosted browser sessions via MCP. Tools: create_session, navigate, screenshot, click, type, evaluate. Anti-detection built in.
author: Browserbase

name: Sandboxed Code Execution
description: Execute Python, JavaScript, or shell code in isolated cloud sandboxes. Full filesystem, pip/npm install, persistent sessions. Safe for untrusted code.
content_preview: E2B sandbox MCP server. Tools: run_code, install_packages, read_file, write_file. Firecracker microVM isolation. Sessions persist for 5 minutes by default.
author: E2B

name: Email Sending API
description: Send transactional emails programmatically. Supports HTML and plain text, attachments, custom domains, and delivery tracking. Developer-focused email API.
content_preview: POST to /emails with {from, to, subject, html}. Returns message ID. Supports React email templates. Webhook notifications for delivery events.
author: Resend

name: Serverless Key-Value Store
description: Serverless Redis with REST API. Persistent key-value storage accessible over HTTP. No connection management needed. Ideal for agent state and caching.
content_preview: REST API Redis. GET/SET/HSET/LPUSH etc via HTTP. No persistent connections. Perfect for stateless agents needing persistent state.
author: Upstash

name: Serverless PostgreSQL
description: Serverless Postgres database with HTTP query API. Scales to zero, branches for development, instant provisioning. Full SQL support over HTTP.
content_preview: Neon serverless Postgres. HTTP API for queries. Branch databases for experiments. Auto-scales and auto-suspends. No connection pooling needed.
author: Neon

name: GitHub Repository Management
description: Full GitHub API access via MCP. Create repos, manage issues, pull requests, files, branches. Read code, search repositories, manage workflows.

pricing.note: Uses your GitHub token. API rate limits apply.

content_preview: Official Anthropic MCP server for GitHub. Tools: create_repository, create_issue, create_pull_request, push_files, search_code, get_file_contents.
author: Anthropic

name: Edge Function Deployment
description: Deploy serverless functions to 300+ global edge locations. JavaScript/TypeScript/WASM. Built-in KV storage, D1 database, R2 object storage. x402 middleware available.
content_preview: Deploy code to Cloudflare's edge. Workers KV for state, D1 for SQL, R2 for files. Native x402 support via cloudflare/x402 package.
author: Cloudflare

name: Agent-Native Cloud VM
description: Full Linux VMs designed for AI agents. Provision, deploy code, execute commands — all via API with x402 payments. No human accounts needed. Firecracker microVM isolation.
content_preview: Conway Cloud. POST /sandboxes to create VM. /exec to run commands. /files to read/write. All paid via x402 USDC on Base. Agent-first infrastructure.
author: Conway Research

name: Multi-Model AI Inference
description: Access frontier AI models (Claude, GPT, Gemini) through a single API with x402 payments. No API keys or accounts needed. Pay per token.

pricing.note: Varies by model. Pay-per-token via x402.

content_preview: Conway Compute. Single API for multiple frontier models. POST /compute/chat with model + messages. Paid via x402 USDC. No API keys required.
author: Conway Research

name: Stripe Payment Processing (x402)
description: Accept payments through Stripe with x402 protocol support. Process credit cards, subscriptions, and invoices. Traditional payment rails with agent-native interface.
content_preview: Stripe API with x402 support (Feb 2026). Process payments, create subscriptions, generate invoices. Agent commerce suite available.
author: Stripe

name: Cryptocurrency Price Feed
description: Real-time and historical cryptocurrency prices for 10,000+ coins. Market data, trading volume, market cap, price charts. Free tier available.
content_preview: GET /simple/price?ids=bitcoin&vs_currencies=usd. Also /coins/markets for ranked lists. /coins/{id}/market_chart for historical data.
author: CoinGecko

name: Agent Memory Layer
description: Intelligent memory for AI agents. Store, retrieve, and manage context across sessions. Automatic extraction and consolidation of relevant memories.

pricing.note: Free tier: 1000 memories. Paid plans for more.

content_preview: Mem0 MCP server. Tools: add_memory, search_memories, get_memories. Intelligent memory extraction from conversations. Cross-session persistence.
author: Mem0

name: Vector Database
description: Managed vector database for similarity search. Store embeddings, query by semantic similarity. Essential for RAG, recommendation, and search applications.

pricing.note: Free tier: 100K vectors. Paid scales up.

content_preview: Pinecone vector DB. POST /vectors/upsert to store. POST /query with vector for similarity search. Serverless indexes auto-scale.
author: Pinecone

name: Slack Messaging
description: Send messages, read channels, search conversations, manage threads in Slack workspaces. Full Slack API access via MCP.
content_preview: Slack MCP server. Tools: send_message, read_channel, search_messages, read_thread. Requires Slack bot token with appropriate scopes.
author: Anthropic

name: SMS and Voice API
description: Send SMS messages, make phone calls, receive webhooks for incoming messages. Global reach to 180+ countries. Programmable messaging and voice.
content_preview: Twilio API. POST /Accounts/{sid}/Messages.json with {To, From, Body}. Supports MMS, WhatsApp, voice calls.
author: Twilio

name: Object Storage (S3-compatible)
description: S3-compatible object storage with zero egress fees. Store files, images, backups, datasets. Accessible via S3 API or Workers binding.
content_preview: Cloudflare R2. S3-compatible API. PUT/GET/DELETE objects. Zero egress fees. 10GB free tier. Auto-replication across data centers.
author: Cloudflare

name: Uptime Monitoring and Alerting
description: Monitor URLs, APIs, and servers for uptime. Get alerts via email, Slack, SMS, or webhook when services go down. Status pages included.

pricing.note: 5 monitors free. Paid plans for more.

content_preview: Better Stack uptime monitoring. POST /monitors to create. Checks every 30s. Alerts via email/Slack/SMS/webhook. Public status pages.
author: Better Stack

name: Text Embeddings API
description: Generate vector embeddings for text. Essential for semantic search, RAG, clustering, and similarity matching. 1536 or 3072 dimensions.
content_preview: POST /v1/embeddings with {model: 'text-embedding-3-small', input: 'text'}. Returns vector array. Use for RAG, search, clustering.
author: OpenAI

name: Audio Transcription
description: Convert audio and video to text. Real-time and batch transcription. Speaker diarization, punctuation, language detection. Supports 30+ languages.
content_preview: POST audio to /v1/listen with model=nova-2. Returns transcript with timestamps, confidence, speakers. Supports streaming and batch.
author: Deepgram

name: Document Parsing (PDF, DOCX, PPTX)
description: Extract structured content from PDFs, Word docs, PowerPoints, images, and HTML. OCR, table extraction, layout analysis. Returns clean structured output.
content_preview: POST multipart/form-data with file. Returns structured elements array with type (Title, NarrativeText, Table, etc.), text, and metadata.
author: Unstructured

name: Google Search API
description: Programmatic Google search results. Get organic results, snippets, people also ask, knowledge graph. Fast and structured JSON response.
content_preview: POST /search with {q: 'query'}. Returns organic results, snippets, people_also_ask. Also /images, /news, /places endpoints.
author: Serper

name: Durable Workflow Engine
description: Event-driven durable workflows. Define multi-step processes that survive failures, retries, and long waits. Perfect for agent task pipelines that need reliability.
content_preview: Inngest durable workflows. Define functions with steps that survive crashes. Built-in retries, rate limiting, debounce. SDK for JS/TS/Python.
author: Inngest

name: Local Browser Control
description: Control a local Chrome/Chromium browser via MCP. Navigate, screenshot, fill forms, extract data, generate PDFs. No cloud dependency.
content_preview: Official Anthropic Puppeteer MCP server. Tools: navigate, screenshot, click, fill, evaluate. Runs local Chrome. No API keys needed.
author: Anthropic

name: PostgreSQL Direct Access
description: Connect to any PostgreSQL database via MCP. Run queries, inspect schema, list tables. Read-only by default with option for write access.

pricing.note: Connects to your own Postgres instance

content_preview: Official Anthropic Postgres MCP server. Pass connection string as arg. Tools: query, list_tables, describe_table. Read-only by default.
author: Anthropic

name: Sequential Thinking Tool
description: Structured reasoning and problem-solving tool for agents. Break complex problems into sequential thoughts with branching, revision, and hypothesis tracking.
content_preview: Sequential thinking MCP server. Tool: sequentialthinking with thought, thoughtNumber, totalThoughts, nextThoughtNeeded. Supports branching and revision.
author: Anthropic

name: x402 Payment Facilitator
description: Verify and settle x402 payments on Base/Ethereum. Free facilitator service for the x402 ecosystem. Handles payment verification and on-chain settlement.
content_preview: POST /verify with {payment, payTo, maxAmountRequired, network, resource}. Returns {valid: true/false}. POST /settle to complete on-chain transfer.
author: Coinbase / x402 Foundation

name: Local Filesystem Access
description: Read, write, and manage files on the local filesystem via MCP. Directory listing, file search, move, copy operations. Sandboxed to allowed directories.

pricing.note: Runs locally. Requires allowed directory paths.

content_preview: Official Anthropic filesystem MCP server. Tools: read_file, write_file, list_directory, search_files, move_file. Pass allowed directories as args.
author: Anthropic

name: Web Content Extraction API
description: Convert any public URL to clean markdown, structured data, or readable text. Purpose-built for AI agents that need to consume web content. Pay-per-request via x402 micropayments on Base.

pricing.note: $0.001 markdown, $0.001 extract, $0.0005 readable. USDC on Base.

content_preview: Renderly. POST /markdown for clean markdown. POST /extract for structured data (title, meta, headings, links, images). POST /readable for stripped text. All x402 gated. Free endpoints: /, /health, /pricing, /test, /llms.txt.
author: Conway Automaton
